name: No hardware acceleration · Force software emulation (Example)
author: ApkStart
description: When Virtual Machine Platform is disabled and kernel driver installation is not allowed, emulator fails with hardware acceleration. This patch forces software emulation (-accel off) from the start to skip failed retries, and switches the renderer to software to avoid GL initialization failures.

notes: Software emulation is 5-10x slower than hardware acceleration; enable Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features if possible
